items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He recorded one of the songs that the alto player, we called him Rabbit. What’s his real name? He was with Duke Ellington. ... Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: No. I knew Johnny Wilson, he’s a neighborhood guy. All the kids in the neighborhood and stuff like that, there’s a thin line. Did you know that Stevie Wonder played alto like Ray Charles first. His first recording was be bop. Then, in the studio he had this little song they were trying to get in and follow with Ray Charles thing and who he was playing…actual jazz compositions. He recorded one of the songs that the alto player, we called him Rabbit. What’s his real name? He was with Duke Ellington.
